record_semantics: A disclosed subset of completed experiments; retained observations are unchanged. Release documentation is not a new preregistration.
input_policy: Replay the shipped frozen INPUTS and CONFIG files. Historical input-generation campaigns are outside this release.

2026-10-12-ouro-advisor-stagecd.scope: Native one-hop/two-hop gate; Q, K and V freezes with matched-size controls; same-example and shuffled late-query rescue at loop 1 and loop 2. Original bootstrap seed and Bonferroni-4 rescue intervals are retained.

2026-10-12-ouro-rescue-audit.scope: Saved operand-isolation diagnostics and the replication on 300 new Ouro-2.6B scenes. Final-position query patches keep all other positions unchanged. The archived factor controls use the original same-scene inputs.

2026-10-12-ouro-rescue-controls.scope: Same-item all-layer query replication and V_F / KV_F / KV_memory co-freezes. The primary KV_F minus V_F contrast retains the original Bonferroni-2 correction.

2026-10-12-ouro-stage-e-swap.scope: All-head crossed query swaps at recipient loops 1 and 3. Recipient and donor ask about the same person with different bridge boxes. Recipient answer, donor bridge, donor answer and donor line predictions differ on every scene.

2026-10-12-ouro-converse-kv.scope: Compare late Q with late K, V and KV at the used facts, and late KV at all positions except the final query. Same-item and shuffled-donor controls and the original primary Bonferroni-2 interval are retained.

2026-10-12-ouro-template-transfer.scope: Native gates and all-head same/shuffled rescue on V1_order_distract, V2_new_surface and V3_both, including the failed 1.4B gates. Rescue on failed-gate cells is descriptive.

2026-10-12-ouro-natural-kv-fc.scope: Natural four-candidate Q/K/V freezes against the bridge-given question. Q freezes the question span; K/V freeze the fact span. Composition selectivity remains near zero.

2026-10-12-ouro26-natural-rescue-fc-powe.scope: The frozen 1,105-item natural QA set, candidate ranking, target screen, same-item query, shuffled donor and same-loop donor. Gold answer is candidate zero; candidates use length-normalized log-likelihood.

2026-10-15-dense-control.scope: Qwen3-1.7B-Base depth-offset control. Retain all specified exits and offsets, same/shuffled queries and the inconclusive 10-point bound.

2026-10-15-ouro-format-transfer.scope: Gate and all-head rescue for lockers, rooms, cars and story formats. Donor prompts have the same token length.

2026-10-15-ouro-entity-scale.scope: Gate and all-head rescue on 8- and 16-entity scenes. Keep the failed 1.4B 16-entity gate. Scoring uses the corresponding number of candidates.

2026-10-15-ouro14-rescue-replication.scope: All-head query rescue on the 400 frozen host scenes. Targets are wrong at loop 1 and right at loop 3. The published replication is 81.8% of 170 targets.

2026-10-16-format-scale.scope: Four formats at 8/16 entities. Preserve all native gates, the 1.4B failed gates, and the same/shuffled rescue in eligible cells.

2026-10-16-freegen-rescue.scope: Greedy generation scored from the first alphabetic word under the original rule. Preserve the 1.4B zero-color output and zero rescue, and the 2.6B positive rescue.

2026-10-16-layerskip8b-control.scope: LayerSkip-Llama3-8B depth-offset rescue control, including the exit-16 primary contrast. This control does not isolate recurrence as the cause of rescue.

2026-10-17-matched-composition-control.scope: Equal-length two-hop and bridge-given questions on the same facts. The query-freeze loss difference M retains the original paired Bonferroni-2 intervals.

2026-10-17-matched-control-per-line.scope: Freeze the person-to-box and box-to-color lines separately. Retain the shared-line comparison and the limitation that the bridge-given question does not read the person-to-box line.

2026-10-17-nl-band-control.scope: All heads in the last quarter of Ouro-2.6B layers, with the original shuffled donor and an independent donor map. Keep the strong shuffled-donor baseline.

2026-10-17-nl-crossover.scope: Ouro-2.6B natural crossed swap on the original edited passages. Keep all-layer and last-quarter all-head arms, unrelated-donor controls, the paired gate and the unsupported primary redirection contrast.

2026-10-17-nl-fresh-replication.scope: The independent 646-item 2Wiki replication. Retain source/QA/evidence/hop exclusions, all-layer and last-quarter all-head rescue with paired shuffled controls.

2026-10-17-nl-ouro14-boundary.scope: Ouro-1.4B on the same 1,105 items: native loop gain, all-layer same/shuffled query rescue, identity diagnostics and the null rescue result.
